title: What if the Negreira-era titles went to the runner-up?
checked: Real totals after 2025-26: Real Madrid 36, Barcelona 29, Atlético 11 (Wikipedia champions list; TopEndSports winners list). The nine Barça titles 2004-05 to 2017-18 and their runners-up (Madrid eight times, Atlético 2017-18) from the same two lists. Cumulative counts by year computed from Wikipedia's season-by-season champions table. Messi's ten La Liga titles = the nine plus 2018-19 (Wikipedia Messi, champions list); Ronaldo at Madrid 2009-2018 won 2011-12 and 2016-17 (Wikipedia Ronaldo, champions list); Guardiola's three titles 2008-09 to 2010-11. Everything 'alternate' is simple arithmetic, labelled as imagination; payments 2001-2018 and 'no court has removed a title' from Al Jazeera 3 Oct 2026 and Wikipedia. Barça won 1997-98 and 1998-99, then not again until the nine; so with the nine removed the next is 2018-19 (Wikipedia champions list).

lines.text: Imagine a different world. Every league Barcelona won in the Negreira years goes to the team that finished second.
lines.say: Imagine a different world. Every league Barcelona won in the Negrayra years goes to the team that finished second.

lines.text: Just to be clear: this never happened. No court has taken a title away, and Barcelona deny any wrongdoing.

scene.sub: No title removed · no verdict · Barça deny it

lines.text: Between 2001 and 2018, Barça won nine leagues. Real Madrid were second in eight of them. Atlético in the other.
lines.say: Between two thousand and one and twenty eighteen, Barsah won nine leagues. Rayal Madrid were second in eight of them. Atleteeko in the other.

lines.text: Real life today: Real Madrid thirty-six titles, Barcelona twenty-nine. A gap of seven.
lines.say: Real life today: Rayal Madrid thirty-six titles, Barcelona twenty-nine. A gap of seven.

lines.text: In our world, Madrid jump to forty-four. Barça crash to twenty. The gap? Twenty-four.
lines.say: In our world, Madrid jump to forty-four. Barsah crash to twenty. The gap? Twenty-four.

lines.text: Barcelona go twenty years without a league title, from 1999 all the way to 2019.

alt.label: What if: no title from 1999 to 2019

lines.say: Barcelona go twenty years without a league title, from nineteen ninety-nine, all the way to twenty nineteen.

lines.text: And Atlético get twenty eighteen, taking them from eleven titles to twelve.
lines.say: And Atleteeko get twenty eighteen, taking them from eleven titles to twelve.

lines.text: Now the fun part. Guardiola's Barça, the team that changed football, would have zero league titles.
lines.say: Now the fun part. Gwardeeohlah's Barsah, the team that changed football, would have zero league titles.

lines.text: Cristiano Ronaldo won two leagues in nine years at Madrid. In this world? Seven.
lines.say: Cristeeahno Ronaldo won two leagues in nine years at Madrid. In this world? Seven.

lines.text: And Lionel Messi, ten La Liga titles in real life, would have just one. Twenty nineteen.
lines.say: And Leeonel Messi, ten La Leega titles in real life, would have just one. Twenty nineteen.

lines.text: A totally different history of Spanish football, and a very different Messi versus Ronaldo argument.
lines.say: A totally different history of Spanish football, and a very different Messi versus Ronaldo argument.

lines.text: But that world is made up. Back in this one, every title stands, there's no verdict, and the case is still open.

scene.sub: Every title stands · case still open
